name: Copper Busbars
summary: Solid and punched electrolytic copper busbars for switchgears, panels, switchboards and transformers.
intro: An easy and economical way to carry current inside switchgears, panels, switchboards and transformers. Busbars are cut from electrolytic copper and supplied plain or tin electroplated, in lengths up to 2 metres.
Solid, punched and threaded busbars are offered. The tables below list the standard metric sizes and codes; any other size can be made to your drawing.
features: Variants: solid busbars, punched busbars, threaded busbars
